Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Two layouts now: portrait and landscape, with an overhauled UI across the plugin - new fonts, resized icons and buttons, and rounded corners throughout. Role slots fall back to sensible defaults when auto-select jobs is off instead of leaving every seat free-for-all, and a preset carries only as many seats as its content actually fields. A new spoiler setting hides and locks duties your character has not unlocked. The PF Analysis button steps aside while the game's own recruitment window is open, FATEs and The Hunt keep recruiting on your own world, and Clears notifies you of each new clear. Fixes: presets no longer save without pressing Save, dungeons are no longer sized as a full party, and Omit removes a role again.
